## Highlights

### 🆕 GOG games installed with Lutris
GOG games installed through Lutris' GOG integration are now detected and launched:
- Works with recent Lutris versions, which keep their game configs in `~/.local/share/lutris`, and with the
  Flatpak build (`net.lutris.Lutris`).
- The game folder is the real one, even when the executable sits deeper (Cyberpunk 2077: `bin/x64`).
- The Play button starts the game through Lutris.

### 🛡️ Game versions the Nexus file database doesn't know
The file database NMA uses to recognize original game files stopped being updated in September 2025, so newer
versions (e.g. Cyberpunk 2077 2.5) were reported as "not a clean install" with every game file as an extra file,
and "Clean folder" or stopping to manage the game deleted the whole game.
- NMA now takes the game folder as it first indexed it as the original game files.
- Adding such a game shows a notice instead: remove the mods you installed by hand before continuing.
- A game file replaced by a mod is backed up and restored when the mod is removed.

### 🔄 Update notifications
The app now finds new releases again: the first releases were tagged `V1.0.0`/`V1.0.1`, which made the update check
pick `V1.0.0` as the latest and stay silent.

### 🐛 Mod files and downloads
- Two mods shipping the same file both keep it: a cleanup could remove it from one of them.
- A mod file you delete stays deleted while the mod stays enabled; re-enabling a disabled mod restores its files.
- A download is marked completed as soon as it finishes, instead of sometimes staying "in progress".
- Leftover `.tmp` archives from interrupted operations are cleaned up at startup (each could take as much space as the
  game).

### 🏷️ NMA Community Edition towards Nexus Mods
- The app identifies itself as NMA Community Edition to the Nexus Mods API, and collections created with it say so.
- The option to send diagnostic and usage data to Nexus Mods is removed: no such data is sent.

## Full changelog

- `feat(games)` detect & launch GOG games installed via Lutris on Linux
- `fix(lutris)` detect games with recent Lutris versions and Flatpak, use the real game folder, launch by slug
- `feat(sync)` use the game folder as first indexed when the game version is unknown
- `fix(updates)` read `V`-prefixed release tags and sort releases consistently
- `fix(sync)` stop pruning LoadoutFiles that other mods share
- `fix(sync)` keep deleted mod files deleted until the mod is re-enabled
- `fix(downloads)` mark a download completed when its Nexus Mods job completes
- `fix(gc)` clean up orphan .tmp archives from aborted repacks
- `chore` identify as NMA Community Edition to Nexus Mods, remove the tracking option, link to the renamed repository
- `ci` build the AppImage on every push, run the test suite on Linux, automate releases

## Install

Download `NMAcommunity.App.x86_64.AppImage` below, `chmod +x`, run.
